title: Setup Checklist Configuration (com.jamf.setupchecklist)
description: Configuration profile schema for Setup Checklist - a macOS first-login experience app for Jamf-managed devices

DEBUG.title: Debug Mode
DEBUG.description: When enabled, the app will not perform actions that change settings. Other apps are not hidden and icon always shows in Dock.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Icon used at the top of the sidebar (90x90 pixels, 180x180 @2x). Can be an image source: path, url, name:, symbol:, or bundle identifier

oneOf.title: Localized
oneOf.description: Dictionary with language codes as keys (e.g. en, de, fr, nl)

title.title: Title
title.description: Title shown at the top of the sidebar, under the icon

oneOf.title: Localized
oneOf.description: Dictionary with language codes as keys (e.g. en, de, fr, nl)

message.title: Message
message.description: Short message shown under the icon and title in the sidebar (supports Markdown)
message.default: Start here to set up your Mac.

oneOf.title: Localized
oneOf.description: Dictionary with language codes as keys (e.g. en, de, fr, nl)

accentColor.title: Accent Color
accentColor.description: Accent color for buttons, progress bar, and UI elements. Format: #RRGGBB or ##colorname (e.g., ##green, ##blue)

hideOtherApps.title: Hide Other Apps
hideOtherApps.description: Controls whether other apps are hidden at launch (not hidden in DEBUG mode)

finishedScript.title: Finished Script
finishedScript.description: Script to be run when user clicks Done

openWhenFinished.title: Open When Finished
openWhenFinished.description: Item to open when user clicks Done (absolute path, URL scheme, or bundle identifier)

openWhenFinishedHide.title: Open When Finished Hide
openWhenFinishedHide.description: Determines whether the item designated in `openWhenFinished` is launched hidden.

links.rel: Detailed documentation: Open When Finished Hide

showIconInDock.title: Show Icon in Dock
showIconInDock.description: Controls whether app icon is shown in the Dock (always shows in DEBUG mode)

links.rel: Detailed documentation: Show Icon in Dock

allowQuit.title: Allow Quit
allowQuit.description: Controls whether the user can quit the app. When false, the Quit menu item, its Cmd-Q shortcut, and the window's close button are disabled so the user cannot leave before completing the workflow. The app still quits automatically when all steps are completed.

background.title: Background
background.description: Full-screen background shown when a step's windowPosition is 'focus'. Can be an image source: path, url, name:, symbol:, or 'wallpaper' for the current desktop picture

blur.title: Blur
blur.description: Applies a blur effect to the full-screen background shown when a step's windowPosition is 'focus'

scriptLogging.title: Script Step Logging
scriptLogging.description: When enabled, script execution and output is written to ~/Library/Logs/SetupChecklist-Scripts.log

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: Array of step configurations defining the workflow (REQUIRED)
